mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_id, refresh_token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at, last_used_at FROM user_session WHERE token_id = #{tokenId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_session (user_id, token_id, refresh_token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenId}, #{refreshTokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_session SET revoked_at = NOW() WHERE token_id = #{tokenId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_session SET revoked_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_session SET last_used_at = NOW() WHERE token_id = #{tokenId}
